ADD NEW STOCK ITEM
ADMIN ONLY. Add a new stock record. Use the same main category for different items when you want them counted together. Each subcategory/item can still have its own sticker code. For example: HANDBAGS → Bags → Code H2, HANDBAGS → Bags → Code H3. Both count toward the HANDBAGS total.
